verified_facts.text: The guest rooms take their colour palette from 19th-century Scottish landscape paintings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our guest rooms take their colour palette from 19th-century Scottish landscape paintings: from highland glens to forest ferns and mountain heathers.

verified_facts.text: The rooms use rich tweeds, warm woods and luxurious linens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rich tweeds, warm woods, and luxurious linens bring that landscape indoors.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a historic hotel on George Street in Edinburgh.
verified_facts.excerpt: InterContinental Edinburgh The George is a historic luxury hotel on George Street, one of Edinburgh's most prestigious addresses

verified_facts.text: The Ferrier Suite is in the original townhouse at 25 George Street, once home to the Ferrier family in the late 1700s.
verified_facts.excerpt: located in the original townhouse at 25 George Street, once home to the Ferrier family in the late 1700s

verified_facts.text: The Somerville Suite is named after Mary Somerville, the Edinburgh-born scientist for whom the word 'scientist' was coined.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Somerville Suite is named in honour of Mary Somerville, the Edinburgh-born scientist and visionary thinker for whom the word 'scientist' was coined.

verified_facts.text: The two-bedroom Somerville Suite has views over George Street, roll-top baths and walk-in showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: When you stay in this two-bedroom suite, you will discover views over George Street, roll-top baths, walk-in showers, Bose speakers, and a complimentary minibar.

verified_facts.text: All suites include access to Club InterContinental, the hotel's lounge with added amenities.

verified_facts.text: The suites are situated within the original 18th-century townhouses.
